discovery.about: obscura-render, the optional render layer behind the render feature: CSS cascade and computed style, retained layout on taffy, inline text shaping with cosmic-text, and CPU paint with tiny-skia.
discovery.see: Crate root of the render layer: why it is optional (default builds have no layout or paint), layout primitives such as Rect, Affine2 and transform operations, LayoutStyle, the layout entry points and screenshot_png that DOM APIs, screenshots, screencasts and PDF rely on.

Stylesheet cascade: parses style text into rules once, indexes rules by subject key (id, class, tag), resolves matching declarations for an element from the few candidate rules, handles media types, and tracks invalidation dependencies for retained layout.

Computed style for layout and paint: UA default styles per tag, applying inline and cascaded declarations into LayoutStyle, checking whether an inline style change preserves box metrics, and supports_declaration for CSS.supports and @supports.

DOM integration (the largest file, about 22,000 lines): builds a taffy layout tree from the live DomTree with block, inline, flex, grid, table, float and positioning behavior, retains layout across style and attribute mutations, handles overflow clips, scroll ids and sticky layout, and returns geometry per node.

Real inline text layout via cosmic-text (rustybuzz shaping and UAX 14 line breaking) replacing per-word flex items: the TextEngine, font directory configuration for --font-dir, inline items with owner geometry, and content box helpers.

Paint into a tiny-skia Pixmap: backgrounds, borders, text, images, SVG and canvas surfaces, box shadows and transforms, the RenderResourceCache and loader for images and fonts including dynamic font faces, intrinsic image sizes, and element scroll metrics.

Typed CSS border and outline state shared by style, layout and paint: four-sided values, border styles, border and outline models that keep specified width separate from used width, and border radii resolution.
Offline paint harness binary: reads an HTML file, parses it, paints it at a given viewport and optional base URL, and writes a PNG, for debugging rendering without the browser.

The main layout regression suite (about 120 tests): a Hacker News shaped nested table without site hacks, table widths and rowspans, viewport and dynamic units, aspect ratios, percentage padding, absolute and fixed containing blocks, floats and clearfix bands, and more.

Paint tests for text-decoration: underline, overline and line-through draw in distinct bands, combinations keep each stroke, propagation through inline descendants, transparency and wrapped lines, and supports() for the implemented values.

Provenance of the bundled fonts used as defaults by the renderer: upstream, version, commit, SHA-256 and license for Noto Color Emoji, alongside the DejaVu Sans and Liberation Sans, Serif and Mono files in assets/.
Provenance of the variable-font test fixture: an Inter subset renamed Obscura VF Test with opsz and wght axes, stored as base64 WOFF2 under the SIL Open Font License.
